def transform(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    keycols=None; keyrow=None
    for r in range(H):
        nz=[c for c in range(W) if g[r][c]!=0]
        if len(nz)>=3 and nz==list(range(nz[0],nz[-1]+1)) and len(set(g[r][c] for c in nz))==len(nz):
            if all(g[min(r+1,H-1)][c]==g[r][c] for c in nz):
                keycols=nz; keyrow=r; break
    order=[g[keyrow][c] for c in keycols]
    # key block rows: contiguous rows containing key colors in keycols
    krows=[r for r in range(H) if any(g[r][c] in order for c in keycols)]
    kset={(r,c) for r in krows for c in keycols if g[r][c]!=0}
    cells=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W)
           if g[r][c]!=0 and (r,c) not in kset]
    shape_color=cells[0][2]
    rs=[r for r,c,_ in cells]; cs=[c for r,c,_ in cells]
    top,bot=min(rs),max(rs); left=min(cs)
    ref_idx=order.index(shape_color)
    h=bot-top+1
    pat={(r-top,c-left) for r,c,_ in cells}
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for i,col in enumerate(order):
        newtop=top+(i-ref_idx)*h
        for dr,dc in pat:
            out[newtop+dr][left+dc]=col
    return out
